title: Quaternius · cashier animated civilian
author: Quaternius
description: CC0 cashier from Quaternius Ultimate Modular Women, acquired from agentkaerf/FreeModels mirror of the official pack. https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatemodularwomen.html. Embedded glTF repacked to GLB; retained idle/walk/run/interact/hit/wave clips. Geometry, rig and original materials preserved.

title: Maira’s store · index-only display LODs
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Precomputed index-only display LODs for six CC0 Poly Haven models. Original positions, UVs and normals are reused; full originals retained for close inspection. JSON keys asset/mesh/primitive with replacement indices, source checksums and measured reductions. Generated offline with meshoptimizer, 16% target indices, 0.035 error, locked borders.

title: Dense thrift-store stock · 1,152 individual items
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Twelve shelves, six clothing fixtures and a shoe wall with 1,152 stable individual merchandise IDs, physical placements, prices, names, categories and visual variants. Measured shelf-board heights for the selected Poly Haven fixtures. Each item can be independently collected/returned.

exports.name: attach
exports.does: Create a fresh merchandise catalog, optionally transform each item.

hooks.name: transformItem
hooks.does: Override placement, price or visual metadata for a new catalog.

title: Maira’s Dream · escalating shopping and stealth rules
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Integer-cent basket/returns/checkout, concealment, tag switching with witnessed detection, three errands, progressive budgets and escalating cats. Visits 1–2 are affordable; visit 3 requires an unobserved tag change or theft. Pure renderer-independent state with full stable stock bundled; createRun(seed,level).

exports.name: attach
exports.does: Create a level-specific shopping run with update and dispose.

exports.name: createRun
exports.does: Actions and state for a complete visit.

exports.name: levelConfig
exports.does: Budget, cats, speed, fire and manager difficulty.

title: Shop controls · quick pickup and separate inspection
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: WASD/arrows, drag and optional pointer-lock mouse look, sprint, crouch, tool/tag holds, immediate use and separate inspection. Pointer capture, multi-touch protection, clear on blur and disposal. Derived from the warehouse FPS input contract.

exports.name: attach
exports.does: Input state and callbacks for desktop/touch first-person shopping.

title: Thrift-store audio · footsteps, Foley and NPC murmurs
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: User-gesture Web Audio with decoded Kenney clips, varied concrete footsteps, material impacts, cashier/shopper/manager formant murmurs, hum, doors, checkout, cats, fire and tool hiss. Explicit mute/dispose and diagnostics. No hosted voice service.

exports.name: attach
exports.does: Create reusable store sound methods with update/dispose.

exports.name: createSound
exports.does: Create an audio engine; call start from a user gesture.

options.name: bankURL
options.does: JSON bank of Ogg data URLs; defaults to pinned kenney-thrift-foley or local source bank.
